# head_v1 (vendor copy for the RL URDF pipeline)

Generated by `tools/import_head_v1.py` from `hdgp/assets/simulation_setting/head_v1`
(Fusion `rl_ws / simulation setting`, 2026-09-05). Re-run the tool after the Fusion
export changes; do not edit `urdf/head.urdf` or the meshes by hand.

- 3 links (base/mid/camera) — USD `tilt_link` and `camera_link` are merged into `camera_link`.
- meshes are link-local, meters, scale 1 (visual: OBJ from the Fusion export, collision: USD
  convex-decomposition meshes).
- `head_data.json` carries the axis points, merged inertials and the D435i optical frames
  expressed in `camera_link` (`generate_rl_urdf.py` puts `color_frame` at `head_cam_view`).
- mount height on the body column is NOT here: `generate_rl_urdf.HEAD_MOUNT_XYZ`.
